metric_failure_directions.signed_contrast: Noise, miscentering, nearby structures or a wrongly chosen line can change it; no ground truth or sharpness score.
metric_failure_directions.absolute_source_contrast: Large cancelling opposite contributions can inflate it; not quality or a fraction of signed signal.
metric_failure_directions.denominator_share: Weights choose source influence, not true physical ownership; fallback shares are1/488.
metric_failure_directions.f64_accounting: Rejects missing numerical contributions only, not bad source/geometry/quality choices.

scope: Frozen actual CFA profiles before demosaic/development, not an RGB quality or flat-noise measurement.
